cortex acp serve

Start Cortex Code as an ACP agent (stdio transport)

Options:
      --help                       Show help                           [boolean]
  -c, --connection                 Snowflake connection name            [string]
      --bypass                     Auto-approve all tool calls
                                                      [boolean] [default: false]
  -m, --model                      Model override                       [string]
  -w, --workdir                    Working directory          [string] [default:
            "<audit-checkout>"]
      --plugin-dir                 Plugin directory or GitHub repo (owner/repo,
                                   owner/repo#branch, or URL). Can be repeated.
                                                                         [array]
      --only-explicit-plugins      Load only --plugin-dir plugins and skip
                                   ambient plugins and plugin auto-update
                                                      [boolean] [default: false]
      --only-explicit-skills       Load only project, bundled, profile, session,
                                   and plugin skills  [boolean] [default: false]
      --only-explicit-mcp-servers  Load only explicitly-provided MCP servers and
                                   skip ambient user MCP config
                                                      [boolean] [default: false]
